name: dante32683-mods
description: Claude Code mods: animated subagent crabs, a usage pane, better compaction, and more.

plugins.name: agent-crabs
plugins.description: Above the prompt, one animated pixel Clawd per running subagent, acting out what it is doing now.

plugins.name: usage-context
plugins.description: A pane (terminal and Desktop) and a terminal band showing 5-hour and weekly plan usage with burn rate, and where the context window is going.

plugins.name: compact-plus
plugins.description: Better compaction: a searchable history file, handoff-style summary instructions, your messages kept word for word, fresh instruction files, and compaction at turn end while you read.

plugins.name: repo-peers
plugins.description: Tells Claude when other Claude chats are working in the same repo, and which files they edit, so it can message them before work collides.

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: /aside <task>: a background worker (Haiku; "opus:" for Opus) does a side task with tools while the chat goes on; its answer opens in a pane with Send to chat.

plugins.name: bash-fixes
plugins.description: Fixes for Claude's Bash tool on Windows Git Bash: long commands run from a temp script, rg keeps patterns that start with /, a sed -i that changes nothing fails, rm targets that start with a variable get a ${VAR:?} guard, and a double-quoted pwsh -Command body with $ is refused.
